about.title: Profile
about.p1: Much of my work is about keeping the system running when conditions aren't ideal. I designed the plant-to-cloud sync of an industrial platform so sites can keep weighing and dispatching offline, with everything reconciling once the connection is back. I've spent a lot of time making critical processes fast and stable in production, and tracing each incident to its root cause rather than settling for a patch.
about.p2: I work comfortably across backend, frontend and desktop, and I work daily with business stakeholders in English to turn operational processes into technical decisions. Before software I worked in logistics and technical drafting, which still shapes how I approach a system: how its parts interact, how they fail and how they evolve.
about.p3: Outside work I'm building my own SaaS products, with the goal of bringing them to market. I handle the whole product, from the data model and business logic to payments and deployment. Almost everything is in TypeScript, tested from the start and, when the use case calls for it, built to keep working offline.

lab.title: Lab
lab.intro: Side projects where I put what I learn into practice. Each one will live on its own subdomain once it's ready.

items.summary: Evolving a production order, dispatch and weighing platform for a multinational industrial group: Node.js microservices on OpenShift, Vue 3 frontends and an Electron desktop app that runs offline across plants in several European countries, integrated with SAP and AWS. Technical lead of the plant app.

An online education provider's platform: payment gateways for course purchases, internal applications with Node.js, React and Python on DynamoDB and MySQL, and course maintenance in Canvas LMS. Containerized with Docker and deployed on AWS (ECR, ECS, CloudFront).
A used-car marketplace's production website with React, Next.js, Redux, Express and MongoDB, consuming internal and external REST APIs.
Supported students of the Full Stack bootcamp where I trained: answered questions and reviewed exercises and projects in JavaScript, Node.js and React.
Technical design of storage systems: calculations, quotes and CAD drawings to standard. Coordination of on-site assembly crews and incidents.
Architectural and services drawings in AutoCAD for building, infrastructure and international zoo projects (ALZA2, Applus Norcontrol, The Logical Zoo).
